searches.title: Searches
searches.description: Zillow rental search URLs, copied from the browser after setting filters, e.g. https://www.zillow.com/brooklyn-new-york-ny/rentals/?searchQueryState=... A bare region URL like https://www.zillow.com/brooklyn-new-york-ny/rentals/ also works.

maxItems.title: Max rows
maxItems.description: Stop after this many dataset rows in total (a building with several bed types counts once per bed type).

maxPages.title: Max pages per search
maxPages.description: Zillow shows about 41 results per page and stops at 20 pages.

maxDetails.title: Max listing pages per run
maxDetails.description: Each row's own listing page (unit or building page) is read once for description, amenities, pets, laundry, fees, sqft, etc. and cached for 14 days in the key-value store 'nest-zillow-details'. This caps NEW page reads per run; rows beyond the cap go out with cached detail if any, and get read on a later run. 0 = cache only.

proxyCountry.title: Residential proxy country
proxyCountry.description: Two-letter country code for the residential proxy.

blockScripts.title: Block all scripts
blockScripts.description: Load only the server-rendered HTML, no JavaScript (about 10x less proxy traffic; tested working incl. page 2+). Turn off if Zillow starts serving bot checks.

detailStoreName.title: Detail cache store
detailStoreName.description: Named key-value store holding one cached listing-page record per unit (z<zpid>) or building (b<lotId>).

saveRawDetails.title: Save raw listing pages (debug)
saveRawDetails.description: Save the first N listing pages' raw __NEXT_DATA__ JSON to the run's default key-value store as RAW-<key>, for building test fixtures.
